entities.summary: Johan Caspar von Cicignon was a Luxembourg-born soldier and military engineer who spent most of his career in the service of Denmark–Norway. He is most associated with the reconstruction of Trondheim, Norway after the great fire of 1681. Johan Caspar von Cicignon was a military leaders & commanders from Oberwampach (1625, Oberwampach–1696-12-12).
